newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SSAB to restart blast furnace next week.
newsitem.headline: SSAB to restart blast furnace next week.

text.p: Swedish steel producer SSAB said on Wednesday that its second blast furnace at Lulea would be started up again next week.
The furnace, that has a daily production of 4,000 tonnes, has been idle since a breakdown on February 14, a company spokesman said.
"The blast furnace has now been emptied of a large part of its material and it is estimated it will be started up at the end of next week," SSAB said in a statement.
"From then it will take a further week until it is back at full production."
